releases.name: v0.5.15
releases.body:
## What's Changed
- Updated `OuterWildsGameLibs` to fix bugs with OW Patch 13, particularly in  Cheats Mod with resources like health and fuel cheats not working.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dgarroDC/OW_CommonResources/compare/0.5.14...0.5.15

**Note:** This release is in the @dgarroDC fork of Common Resources as a temporal workaround until the main repository is also updated with this fix. Until then, the Outer Wilds Mod Database will use this fork.
